title: FEniCSx and FMI integration surfaces that run without their runtimes
note: Every mutation here is killed by a test that needs neither FEniCSx nor fmpy (the boundary reader, the series check, the slab model, the environment lock policy, the header check; the FMU build needs only a C compiler), so the agent-substrate shards can run it. The runtime-dependent halves run in the harness-integrations workflow, where the runtime is REQUIRED.

mutations.name: FB1_a_member_may_escape_the_archive
mutations.find: if n.startswith("/") or "\\" in n or ".." in n.split("/") or \
mutations.replace: if False and (n.startswith("/") or "\\" in n or ".." in n.split("/")) or \
mutations.rationale: an FMU member named ../x or /abs is extracted wherever it points

mutations.name: FB2_a_link_is_a_member
mutations.rationale: a symlink inside the FMU is followed on extraction

mutations.name: FB3_a_doctype_is_parsed
mutations.find: if b"<!DOCTYPE" in head or b"<!ENTITY" in raw.upper():
mutations.rationale: an entity-expanding model description reaches the XML parser

mutations.name: FB4_any_fmi_version_is_admitted
mutations.rationale: an FMI 2.0 description is read under 3.0 semantics

mutations.name: FB5_an_undefined_unit_is_admitted
mutations.rationale: a variable in a unit the FMU never defines crosses the boundary with no meaning

mutations.name: FB6_an_fmu_may_claim_authority
mutations.rationale: an FMU that says it is AUTHORITATIVE is believed

mutations.name: FB7_an_fmu_may_claim_a_measurement
mutations.rationale: a simulation crosses the boundary labelled as a raw observation

mutations.name: FB8_no_binary_is_needed
mutations.rationale: an FMU without the platform binary it names is admitted

mutations.name: SS1_any_ratio_passes
mutations.find: status = Status.PASS if ratio <= 1.0 else Status.FAIL
mutations.replace: status = Status.PASS if ratio <= 1e9 else Status.FAIL
mutations.rationale: the series check passes a solver with the wrong conductivity

mutations.name: SS2_any_model_is_checked
mutations.rationale: the slab series is applied to a bundle of another model

mutations.name: SS3_the_tolerance_is_unbounded
mutations.rationale: the producer's stated resolution no longer bounds the comparison

mutations.name: ST1_an_odd_resolution_is_run
mutations.rationale: a resolution that cannot be halved is run, and its Richardson estimate compares against a different grid

mutations.name: FE1_any_channel_is_admitted
mutations.rationale: a package from outside conda-forge over https enters the FEniCSx environment

mutations.name: FE2_lock_and_record_may_differ
mutations.rationale: the lock lists a package the sha256 record does not, so it is installed unverified

mutations.name: BU1_a_modified_header_builds
mutations.rationale: the vendored FMI headers can change and the FMU still builds
